payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics comparing the HABCNN system to previous systems, indicating the margin of improvement in accuracy and NDCG.

claims.text: The HABCNN system outperformed the NR system by a margin of 15.6 in accuracy and 16.5 in NDCG on MCTest-150, and by 7.3 in accuracy and 4.6 in NDCG on MCTest-500.
HABCNN consistently outperformed all baseline systems, demonstrating a significant margin over competitive deep learning systems.
